versions.content: Memory stack shall be able to preempt active jobs 17 of 20  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 944: AUTOSAR_RS_FirmwareOverTheAir Requirements on Firmware Over-The-Air AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: draft Description: The memory stack shall preempt an ongoing job, if a higher priority job was requested. The preempted job shall be resumed as soon as the interrupting, higher priority jobs were processed. The preemption shall not be recognized by the user. Rationale: Prioritization of concurrent memory accesses. Dependencies: Use Case: Assuming FOTA writes multiple data chunks, the write job may be preempted, if a memory stack job requests immediate action. After the memory stack job was processed, the processing of the FOTA jobs is resumed. During the preemption time, the FOTA job(s) remain as pending and the FOTA Target waits for the job(s) to finish. Supporting Material:
